edits.hypothesis: Restoring syntactic validity to the ANSWER prompt while retaining general instructions to verify negative findings against original pixels prevents crashes and reduces uncritical acceptance of false negatives without leaking task-specific details.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous edit introduced a syntax error that broke the harness; this fix restores functionality while keeping the behavioral guidance generic.

edits.regression_risk: Minimal; restores valid Python syntax and removes hard-coded task IDs.
